key_difference: On EBUSY, (D) does not simply close the file and unlink again as (B) does: it renames the file to a random temp name with QFileSystemEngine::renameFile, compares inodes, and renames it back if it is not ours. That adds the rename/link fallback path the reviewer questioned, a window where another process's live lock is briefly moved away (and possibly leaked under a .rm.* name), and an autotest-only global, while still not handling the ETXTBSY/EPERM cases that (B) covers.
